description: MainActivity.java is an Android activity class that manages geofences using Google Play Services API. It sets up geofences for predefined locations, handles GoogleApiClient connection lifecycle, and initiates geofence monitoring with transition intents.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages geofences, connecting to Google Play Services API and creating predefined geofences for specific locations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up GoogleApiClient, checks Google Play services availability, and creates geofences.

methods.name: createGeofences
methods.description: Creates and stores hard-coded geofences for specified locations.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Handles failed connection attempts to Google Play Services, attempts resolution if available.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Called upon successful connection; requests to add geofences and shows a toast message.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Handles suspension of API client connection, removes geofences if needed.

methods.name: isGooglePlayServicesAvailable
methods.description: Checks whether Google Play Services are available on the device.

methods.name: getGeofenceTransitionPendingIntent
methods.description: Creates and returns a PendingIntent to trigger GeofenceTransitionsIntentService when geofence events occur.
